summary: Treat browser-session AccessToken values as cookies, hydrate them into the HTTP client jar, and keep bearer tokens on the Authorization header.
reason: auth login --chrome stores a raw cookie header string, and without a real cookie jar the signed-in browser session never reached Perplexity on the wire. The config split prevents browser-cookie sessions from being misclassified as bearer tokens while preserving the existing API-token path.
validated_outcome: go test ./... passes; browser-cookie redirects retain the session cookie and JWT-shaped tokens still emit Bearer auth.
